from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) for the case")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The legal document type (e.g., Administrative Judgment, Civil Ruling)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
